content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for BHU Field Assistant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for BHU Field Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Field Assistant position at Banaras Hindu University is scheduled for 11 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they report to the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Field Assistant post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required for the Field Assistant position is Intermediate. Candidates must have completed their intermediate education to be eligible for this role.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Field Assistant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Field Assistant post is 28 years. Age relaxation is applicable for certain categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Field Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Field Assistant position will receive a fixed salary of Rs. 15000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the BHU Field Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Field Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Field Assistant position will be based on a Walk-in Interview. Candidates are advised to prepare accordingly.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Banaras Hindu University, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh. Specific venue details will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, and photocopies, along with a duly filled application form if required.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the Field Assistant position is a contractual job. The appointment will be on a contractual basis.
